前台的一天(A Day at the front desk): 围绕职场工作的A1短文:介绍凯特的日常、喜好与前台。
Kate drinks tea every morning. My friend David is very kind. I like my life very much. She runs a small business from home.
Kate and David are in the same class. We talk about science a lot. David often helps me with science. He started a small company last year.
David likes chicken too. Kate's favorite season is spring. We often go to the gym together.
